title: Pandian Stores 2
description: As Karthikeyan's family arrives for Arasi's marriage alliance, Pandian's family warmly welcomes them. Seeing Arasi, they give their consent and fix the engagement date.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
episodeTitle: Chozhan and Pandian Spy on Cheran
description: Cheran consoles sleepless Karthika as she shares her worries about life. Meanwhile, Chozhan and Pandian secretly observe them and anxiously wait for them to fall asleep.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: After Vijaya and Sinthamani's fierce dance battle, wedding preparations begin. Unaware that Manoj's brothers are getting remarried, Rohini arrives to stop the wedding.

title: Neeya Naana
description: Gopinath hosts a Neeya Naana debate on food as medicine. Dr. Sivaraman supports diet cures while P.A. Krishnan stresses medical care, leading Gopinath to urge balance.

title: Super Singer Junior
description: A power-packed night of soulful music, side-splitting comedy, and emotional acts. Judges share warm praise and expert guidance for every stunning performance.

title: Cooku With Comali
episodeTitle: Who Will Reach the Grand Finale?
description: Celebrity guests join a thrilling semifinal packed with cuisine challenges and fun tasks. As contestants race to impress the judges, who will emerge as the grand finalists?

title: Connect Link Pannu Win Pannu
description: Kureishi hosts Vijay TV stars in a lively game show where contestants crack word and movie clues, face tie-breakers and pick ATMs for exciting cash prizes.

title: Bigg Boss The Common Man
episodeTitle: The Common Man: Mud, Grit and Glory
description: The Red Rangers and Manpulu teams battle through a muddy coin hunt in which, Priyanka Paul and Muniyamma challenge the verdicts. Was it a fair game?
